body.statement: Can one construct from \(\mathsf{Handle}_{\mathrm{cert}}\) a measurable radius \(R_\ell\) such that \(\mathcal C_\ell(R_\ell)\) has asymptotic coverage at least \(1-\alpha\) uniformly over \(\mathcal M\), has diameter \(O_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-1/2}+m_\ell^{-1/4})\), uses the DKW branch with probability \(o(1)\) on every supported fixed local stratum, satisfies \(R_\ell^2/a_\ell\to c^*(\eta,\alpha)\) conditionally on \(\mathscr S_\eta\), learns within-cell offsets exactly at the local limit while retaining cross-cell translations and face offsets in the nuisance region, and reduces only on fixed separated interior strata with continuous nondegenerate critical law to the corresponding oracle cutoff?
body.justification: This remains load-bearing because the proved pilot-resolution obstruction rules out the mandated pilot-only route on slowly diverging extended local strata, while a different measurable construction using more of the raw sample might still attain the full conditional frontier.
body.gap: The new pilot-resolvable theorem closes measurability, error budgeting, finite work, global honesty, rate, and bounded-offset stress testing, but it does not close sharp convergence for root-scale face or cross-cell offsets that diverge more slowly than the pilot's \(n_\ell^{1/8}\) or \(m_\ell^{1/8}\) uncertainty.
body.consumer: The proved procedure supports an unsmoothed simultaneous \(L^2\) abundance-QTE analysis with conservative calibration on ambiguous diagonals; claiming stratum-specific sharp calibration for such arrays must await a construction that overcomes the obstruction.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct a measurable sharp calibration that attains the stratum-specific conditional cutoff also on diagonal arrays whose cross-cell knot translations or simplex-face offsets diverge more slowly than the full-root-scale uncertainty of every \(n_\ell^{3/4}\) or \(m_\ell^{3/4}\) pilot.
obligation.obstruction: The proved total-variation witnesses have offsets \(n_\ell^{1/16}\) and \(m_\ell^{1/16}\): they diverge in the full local experiment, so their separated or inactive-face cutoffs differ from the boundary or collision cutoffs, but their pilot laws are asymptotically indistinguishable.  Therefore the mandated pilot-only geometry selection cannot converge to both cutoffs.
obligation.attempted: A deterministic pilot split, variance-adaptive multinomial regions, exhaustive support/rank/face enumeration, rational Gaussian interval certification, explicit transfer and exclusion budgets, and a finite work cap were constructed.  They prove global honesty, the optimal diameter order, vanishing fallback, and cutoff convergence whenever each root-scale coordinate is bounded or dominates the pilot uncertainty.  Conservative grouping preserves coverage on the diagonal arrays but converges to the wrong stratum-specific sharp cutoff.
obligation.partial_result: The exact finite expansion, conditional Gaussian cutoff, oracle tail-box algorithm, and DKW ball are already proved.  This round additionally proves a uniform triangular pre-score linearization with \(w_\ell\to w^0\) and \(\Omega_\ell\to\Omega\), constructs a total Borel pilot-split certified radius with explicit primitive-exclusion, Gaussian-transfer, linearization, tail, center-translation, and interval budgets, proves global uniform coverage and diameter \(O_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-1/2}+m_\ell^{-1/4})\), and proves conditional convergence to \(c^*(\eta,\alpha)\) on the stated pilot-resolvable regimes.  A \(J=2\), \(S=3\) bounded face-plus-collision experiment with a middle mass \(d/\sqrt{m_\ell}\) satisfies \(\sqrt{m_\ell}N_\ell/\lceil m_\ell^{3/4}\rceil\to d\), retains the bounded face and cross-cell offsets, has vanishing fallback, and attains the conditional common cutoff.  However, pilots of sizes \(n_\ell^{3/4}\) and \(m_\ell^{3/4}\) have full root-scale errors \(n_\ell^{1/8}\) and \(m_\ell^{1/8}\).  Legal offsets \(n_\ell^{1/16}\) and \(m_\ell^{1/16}\) diverge in the full experiment while their pilot laws are contiguous to the boundary or collision pilot laws.  Therefore the mandated pilot architecture cannot attain the stratum-specific cutoff on every supported extended local stratum.
